english.title: Allow removed item to re-enter airport within 24 hours without authorisation - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), removed

(A)_[a vehicle]_
(B)_[an animal]_
(C)_[an item,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE ANIMAL OR ITEM..), from the Liverpool John Lennon Airport, when requested to do so, unlawfully allowed it to re-enter the airport within 24 hours of its removal
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(b) and 3(10) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.

english.notes: Byelaw 1(3) states that the offence will not be committed by any member of a fire, police or ambulance service acting in the course of their duty or to any emergency vehicle being used by such a person.
